pages.name: Hungarian Defence
pages.notes: Plan 3 sent the knight 'to f1-g3' (an unreadable route, and a slow-Italian idea that doesn't fit 4.d4); plan 1 offered c3 after d4 was played. Rewrote plans 1 and 3 and added 4.d4 to the overview; British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Classical Variation, Albin Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 2 named ...exd4 before White's d4; plan 3 credited White with a central pawn majority that doesn't exist. Rewrote plans 2 and 3; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Italian Game: Giuoco Pianissimo
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted the knight via Nbd2-f1-g3 when it already stands on c3 (which also blocks the c-pawn). Rewrote plans 1 and 2 and the overview; British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Giuoco Pianissimo, Canal Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 named White's Bh4 in a Black plan; plan 1's Bxf6 'damaging the pawn structure' (the queen recaptures, and 8.Nd5 is the point). Rewrote the overview and plans 1 and 3.

pages.name: Italian Game: Jerome Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1's Qh5 was blocked by the f3-knight and missed the real lines (5.Nxe5+ Nxe5 6.d4 or 6.Qh5+); plan 3's ...Ke6 king walk replaced with the known 6.Qh5+ g6 7.Qxe5 d6 defence. British spelling throughout.

pages.name: Italian Game: Paris Defense
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed a knight via d2-f1-g3 with the d2-pawn and f1-bishop still at home; rewritten with castling, d3 and Re1 first. British spelling in the overview (including the opening's name) and the other plans.

pages.name: Italian Game: Rousseau Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 4 called d4 and e5 light squares; rewritten around the half-open f-file and the weakened light squares near Black's king. British spelling in plan 1.

pages.name: Evans Gambit Accepted, 5.c3
pages.notes: Plan 1's 'weak points (f7, c5)' rewritten around Qb3 and Ba3 stopping short castling; plan 2 now names the bishop's retreats. British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Evans Gambit Declined, Pavlov Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1's knight route was unreadable and ignored the threat to g2 from the queen and g8-rook; plans 1 and 2 rewritten around that threat and the piece-for-four-pawns balance.

pages.name: Italian Game: Evans Gambit, Anderssen Variation, Cordel Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 developed the b1-knight to c3 (the c3-pawn stands there); rewritten around 7.Be2 or 7.Nxe5 Nxc4 8.Nxc4. British spelling in plans 2 and 3.
